# Jolito

> Spoken Mexican Spanish flashcards built for active recall, spaced repetition, and real-world conversation. Jolito turns daily language practice into a fast, rewarding habit with natural audio pronunciation, instant visual typo diffs, and zero-friction keyboard reviews.

## Origin Story

In July 2026, my wife *(Mexican)*, our twins *(Gexican)*, and I *(German)* moved to Mexico City. I started learning Spanish at the [International House in Condesa](https://ihmexico.mx/). The classes were fantastic—but memorizing vocabulary? **My archenemy.** The absolute worst part of learning a new language!

I needed what I learned in class and heard on the streets to stick. While Anki provided the unbeatable spaced repetition algorithm needed for long-term retention, manually creating rich cards—clipping audio, finding pictures, and wrestling templates—felt like an exhausting chore at the end of a long day. Gamified apps looked great and sounded natural, but locked learners into rigid beginner courses with zero control over the real-world phrases they actually wanted to speak.

I built Jolito to make memorization something to look forward to: **fast, tactile, immersive**. Spaced repetition games your memory—**legally!** It resurfaces words just before you forget them, so they stick almost effortlessly.

Memorization and I have become friends!

## Highlights & Learner Experience

- **Fast Keyboard & Gesture Flow:** Fly through reviews with `Enter` to reveal, `1`–`4` to grade, and `Space` for audio on desktop, or natural mobile swipe gestures (swipe up to reveal, swipe horizontally to grade) with continuous spring settling.
- **Spoken Mexican Spanish Audio:** High-quality studio neural audio (alternating male/female) for prompts and answers with automatic playback on reveal and smart prefetching.
- **Active Typed Recall & Visual Diffs:** Produce words actively with sub-word typo highlighting and accent-sensitive diffs while retaining full authority over self-grading.
- **Focused Grammar Practice:** Bite-sized drills for tricky conjugations—Pretérito Indefinido, Pretérito Perfecto Compuesto, and Gerundio—with numbered accent shortcuts and subject-verb matching.
- **Curated Starter Packs:** Built-in decks (Top Connectors, Adjectives, Idioms, Adverbs) that merge semantically into your deck without overwriting your progress.
- **Instant Reciprocal Cards:** Type a Spanish or English phrase to get instant translations, lemmas, and conjugations from a bundled Mexican Spanish dictionary, creating linked reciprocal cards simultaneously.
- **Anki Import & Offline JSON Backup:** Bring existing Anki decks (`.apkg` packages or text exports) in seconds, preserving learning history and schedules, or export your full deck to JSON anytime.
- **Native iOS App:** Built for iPhone and iPad with tactile haptics, full offline support, and physical keyboard auto-detection.
- **Offline-First Study & Cloud Backup:** Review, card creation, and audio playback run 100% offline via local storage and service worker caching, syncing unobtrusively with Supabase when online.

## Web Application

- [Jolito Web App](https://joli.to/): Open the live app to study and create Mexican Spanish flashcards.
